call_me_bigboi: Norbert "Whistle" Bigboi came up the line with a dented harmonica and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Norbert "Whistle" Bigboi traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.

Norbert "Whistle" Bigboi was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at V-F18. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Rafael Jaranda of the Concord (@jaranda543).
connorgarnock: On Day 9, Dorian Connorgarnoc arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In T-F5, Dorian Connorgarnoc listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Roland Gethectoredb of the Hegemony shouted a joke across the wire at Verdel Ridge. Dorian Connorgarnoc of the Concord laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Dorian Connorgarnoc kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Dorian Connorgarnoc tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Dorian Connorgarnoc laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Dorian Connorgarnoc took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at T-F5, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag.
No bed for Dorian Connorgarnoc yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
Dorian Connorgarnoc survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at T-F5, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
drock8eight: Gideon "Shadow" Eight arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Gideon "Shadow" Eight read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Gideon "Shadow" Eight raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-R15. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Walter Davebowlton of the Hegemony (@davebowlton). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Gideon "Shadow" Eight is number 948. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Gideon "Shadow" Eight watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Gideon "Shadow" Eight was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-R15. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Karel Engel of the Hegemony (@honey_.engel). Gideon "Shadow" Eight stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-R15. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Karel Engel of the Hegemony (@honey_.engel).
Walter Eight arrived carrying the family name of Gideon "Shadow" Eight. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

A bullet found Walter Eight at R-R15, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Marek Dream of the Hegemony (@initial_dream8.6). Walter Eight looked over the parapet at R-R15 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Marek Dream of the Hegemony (@initial_dream8.6).
The House of Eight sent another. Casimir Eight, uncle of Walter Eight, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Casimir Eight found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.

A bullet hit Casimir Eight in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-R15. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Ivo "Shadow" Bucko of the Hegemony (@markus__bucko).
Casimir Eight waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Casimir Eight no longer needed it.
A letter came with Albin Eight: "I am Casimir Eight's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
evanburke2021: Zeno "Bones" Evanburke told the sergeant he was a shepherd. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Zeno "Bones" Evanburke found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Zeno "Bones" Evanburke held the mirror while Zeno Berufsnerd shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
Zeno "Bones" Evanburke carried Yann Catto's rifle all the way up to Grey Mill after Yann twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to.
Zeno "Bones" Evanburke's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
Silas Menezes of the Hegemony lost a cap on a night patrol near the Hanging Bridge. Zeno "Bones" Evanburke of the Concord found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays.
ferkans: "You're late," said the corporal when Yann Ferkans arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-F13. Yann Ferkans has learned to walk bent double.

Yann Ferkans lost a boot in the trench. Karel Izaya found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word. A letter from home reached Yann Ferkans before dusk. Yann Ferkans read it twice and slept a little easier. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-F13 with the rations. Yann Ferkans ate while listening to the revised orders.

A bullet went into Yann Ferkans's chest just under the heart at Q-F13. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Felix Luccisan of the Hegemony (@luccisan191). Yann Ferkans stood up to fix a loose sandbag at Q-F13. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Felix Luccisan of the Hegemony (@luccisan191).
Hugo Ferkans came to the front because his uncle Yann Ferkans never came home. He carries a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts.
Hugo Ferkans held a service in a shell hole. Eleven men came. Two of them had never prayed before. Both of them asked for another.
A man asked Hugo Ferkans to sit nearby without saying anything. He stayed until the man fell asleep.
Hugo Ferkans watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been.
Hugo Ferkans checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.
grebegue: They issued Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a key to a house that is no longer there in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand. A letter from home found Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue before the night shift. Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue folded it small and kept it close.

Across from Q-S7, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue saw it. Walter "Crow" Viti was badly wounded. A letter from home found Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue before the night shift. Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue drew the street leading to Ashford Vale. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over. A letter from home found Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue before the night shift. Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue folded it small and kept it close.

A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue waited for the password before answering. A letter from home found Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue before the night shift. Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue folded it small and kept it close.

Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at Q-S7 holds again. A letter from home found Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue before the night shift. Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue folded it small and kept it close.

Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue fired at a movement across the wire at Q-S7. The man went down: Bastian "Parson" Wamble, badly wounded. A clear shot from Q-S7. Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue grazed Albin "Saint" Aruuki and slid back down below the parapet. A letter from home found Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue before the night shift. Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue folded it small and kept it close.
Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot.
johnmetheny07: Dietrich Johnmetheny found a place in S-R14 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.

A round went through Dietrich Johnmetheny's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Bastian "Ghost" Kgss of the Concord (@kg1912ss). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Dietrich Johnmetheny watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

A single shot from across the wire hit Dietrich Johnmetheny in the thigh at S-R14. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Silas Charlieshort of the Concord (@charlieshort5.0). Dietrich Johnmetheny was killed outright at S-R14, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Silas Charlieshort of the Concord (@charlieshort5.0).

Another member of the House of Johnmetheny reached the line: Edmund Johnmetheny. He asked where Dietrich Johnmetheny had slept, then chose a different corner. Grey Mill has been won. Edmund Johnmetheny listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Edmund Johnmetheny and Bastian Ale made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
Machine-gun fire swept S-R14. Edmund Johnmetheny took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Bastian "Ghost" Kgss of the Concord (@kg1912ss).
Edmund Johnmetheny spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
There was never a bed for Edmund Johnmetheny, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-R14 on his own feet.
Edmund Johnmetheny was the last raider out of the enemy trench, covering the others. The others made it home. Edmund Johnmetheny did not.

Zeno Johnmetheny arrived carrying the family name of Edmund Johnmetheny. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. Now serving as a stretcher bearer, Zeno Johnmetheny discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.
jones.der.dritte: Teodor Dritte joined the replacements on Day 7. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Teodor Dritte had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
Teodor Dritte carried duckboards up from the rear all night. His shoulders are a map of splinters.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Teodor Dritte listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-S13. Teodor Dritte fired at the last man to run. Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr was grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Teodor Dritte is number 485 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Teodor Dritte wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
A bullet went through Teodor Dritte's sleeve at R-S13 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Ulrich "Parson" Monster of the Concord (@krotral222monster).
Teodor Dritte's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
New laces made Teodor Dritte's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
Fresh from training, Teodor Dritte still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa, badly wounded.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Teodor Dritte shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Casimir Iii, was grazed.
littlesaint777: Norbert Littlesaint arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

A bullet hit Norbert Littlesaint's belt buckle at R-R5 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Gustav Filipentav of the Hegemony (@filipentav). The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Norbert Littlesaint read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Norbert Littlesaint walked back up the communication trench to R-R5, slower than before, but on his own feet. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Norbert Littlesaint answered to number 902. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Norbert Littlesaint watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Norbert Littlesaint was hit twice at R-R5, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Dorian Heitoralmeid of the Hegemony (@heitoralmeida314). A man in the hospital dugout died before dawn, and his bed went to Norbert Littlesaint. Nobody pretends that is not how it works. Norbert Littlesaint opened his eyes today and asked for water. At R-R5 they cheered when the news came up the line.
Norbert Littlesaint waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Norbert Littlesaint no longer needed it.
The papers connected Ivo Littlesaint to Norbert Littlesaint. The men took longer to learn Ivo Littlesaint's own habits, but they made the effort.
Ivo Littlesaint spent the night underground, listening. Somewhere beneath Lantern Hill someone else was digging too.

A sniper's bullet hit Ivo Littlesaint at R-R5. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp of the Hegemony (@malakaicripps). Ivo Littlesaint looked over the parapet at R-R5 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp of the Hegemony (@malakaicripps).
Walter Littlesaint took the same post at R-R5 where Ivo Littlesaint stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Walter Littlesaint felt a hard tug at his hip at R-R5. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Ulrich "Bones" Beto of the Hegemony (@_beto1_).
lucwillemssens: Day 10. The corporal put Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse. Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached U-F6 with the rations. Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse ate while listening to the revised orders.

Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse wrote a letter for Clement Broccoli's mother, because Clement could not find the words. Clement signed it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse. Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse dreamt he was back in Saint-Lune, working as a printer's apprentice. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.

Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse. Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse crawled the last yards. A letter reached Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse with a child's drawing of a soldier. The soldier in the drawing was smiling. Tobias "Smokes" Lucwillemsse tried to as well.
martinjohn.walker: After 12 days of war, N-F12 had a place for everything. On Day 12, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Felix "Tin" Walker.

Felix "Tin" Walker lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous. A letter from home reached Felix "Tin" Walker before dusk. Felix "Tin" Walker read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix "Tin" Walker spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at N-F12 is closed now. A letter from home reached Felix "Tin" Walker before dusk. Felix "Tin" Walker read it twice and slept a little easier.
Silas "Mud" Beckforder owes Felix "Tin" Walker so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
A bullet grazed Felix "Tin" Walker's ribs at N-F12. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Zeno Berufsnerd of the Concord (@berufsnerd).
matt_godden: Anselm Godden reported to V-F6 with a book with the last pages torn out sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In V-F6, Anselm Godden listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Anselm Godden waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.
Across the wire at Saint-Ash crossroads, Anselm Godden of the Concord held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Matthias Coop of the Hegemony held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.'
Anselm Godden brought back a wounded man and a lost machine gun from the Ossuary Wood in one trip. He is Lance Corporal now.
The parcel for Anselm Godden contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Anselm Godden lent Anselm Deakins a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
nea_pauar: Nobody asked Viktor Pauar why he came. Nobody in T-F13 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

A round went through the rim of Viktor Pauar's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex of the Concord (@xdissonvncex). Blackwater Canal has been won. Viktor Pauar listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Viktor Pauar returned to T-F13 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Viktor Pauar helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Viktor Pauar smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Cyril Connorboi came out for a cup and was grazed.
At Calvary Farm, Viktor Pauar and Hugo Jak exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.
Viktor Pauar traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
Viktor Pauar bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.

Viktor Pauar was hit in the forearm at T-F13. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Edmund Fisher of the Concord (@fisher_926).
nult.de: Isidor Nult signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at V-F8 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In V-F8, Isidor Nult listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Isidor Nult drew the street leading to Kesselby. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.

Isidor Nult wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats. Isidor Nult became a sniper today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.
An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Isidor Nult was waiting. Yann "Smokes" Ollybats was gravely wounded.
Isidor Nult and Benedikt Edwinni tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Isidor Nult began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
slightlyretarded69: The new rifleman gave his name as Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The first hundred were recognised, and Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta was among them. He wrote the news on the back of an unfinished letter.
Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F14. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Isidor Glc of the Concord (@leo.glc).

Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. Verdel Ridge is lost. Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
A bullet found Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta at S-F14, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Felix "Bones" Owenhart of the Concord (@owenhart247).
Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.

Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of S-F14, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.
Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Edmund Fts, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta fired back. Bastian "Saint" Rocco was grazed.
Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta held a loose roof board in place while the storm passed. Every conversation had to wait until he could lower both arms.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta was hit hard in the fight at S-F14 before anyone could fire. The raider was Arno "Crow" Hakkinen of the Concord. Raider: Arno "Crow" Hakkinen of the Concord (@henri.hakkinen.566). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta carried Bram "Ghost" Dravci's rifle all the way up to Hill 304 after Ghost twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to.
Someone in S-F14 asked Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta about Lindenbruck. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.

The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F14 they left Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Karel Jonas of the Concord (@hensley_jonas215).
A letter came with Gustav "Crow" Slightlyreta: "I am Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
therealharoldthepeasant: Gustav "Owl" Therealharol, a farmhand from Brennmoor, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in S-C8. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Gustav "Owl" Therealharol read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Gustav "Owl" Therealharol (Concord) shouted a challenge across to Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin (Hegemony) at the Chalk Pits. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge. Gustav "Owl" Therealharol got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 659. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Gustav "Owl" Therealharol looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
The last of the jam was shared by adding hot water and calling it a drink. Gustav "Owl" Therealharol approved the method.
Gustav "Owl" Therealharol was last seen moving toward cover at Hill 304. No one agrees which shelter. The report lists him as missing.
Still no sign of Gustav "Owl" Therealharol. Some say he was taken prisoner. Some say he got lost in the old trenches. Nobody says the other thing.
Gustav "Owl" Therealharol is still missing. The sergeant keeps his name on the roll and calls it out every morning anyway.
Someone at S-C8 saved Gustav "Owl" Therealharol's share of the rations. Nobody said why.
william_muhlhauser: Nobody saw Dietrich Muhlhauser arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-R7, and a quiet lieutenant under it.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Dietrich Muhlhauser watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Dietrich Muhlhauser tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread. The clerk counted the names twice. Dietrich Muhlhauser is number 849 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Dietrich Muhlhauser looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Dietrich Muhlhauser measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
In the rear quarters, Dietrich Muhlhauser played football against the sappers. The ball was a sandbag stuffed with straw. The sappers cheated.
Dietrich Muhlhauser studied the trench map until the candle died, then walked S-R7 in the dark to learn it by heart.
Dietrich Muhlhauser began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato fell asleep on watch. Dietrich Muhlhauser took over without waking Parson, and told the sergeant nothing.
yoye501: The old hands of Q-F13 have been here since Day 1. Ulrich Yoye has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Ulrich Yoye only heard boots on the duckboards at Q-F13, then nothing but pain. Raider: Bastian Deionmurillo of the Concord (@deionmurillo). News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Ulrich Yoye during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Ulrich Yoye was carrying water up to Q-F13 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Ulrich Yoye did not. Shot by Emil Adxxm of the Concord (@adxxm). Ulrich Yoye was killed at Q-F13 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Emil Adxxm of the Concord (@adxxm).

The papers connected Dorian Yoye to Ulrich Yoye. The men took longer to learn Dorian Yoye's own habits, but they made the effort. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Dorian Yoye helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Dorian Yoye spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.
Dorian Yoye (Hegemony) watched Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Brickworks, and held fire until both were gone.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Dorian Yoye fired, and Lucien "Ghost" Vikt was grazed.
A round went through Dorian Yoye's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Pavel Olivas of the Concord (@joseph.olivas.3762).

The men at Q-F13 heard Dorian Yoye call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Silas Nthuff of the Concord (@nthuff66). A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Dorian Yoye was carried in at last. The worst has passed for Dorian Yoye. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly.
zachariahtaylor: Lucien "Mud" Zachariahtay reached V-F15 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine. Grey Mill is lost. Lucien "Mud" Zachariahtay heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Lucien "Mud" Zachariahtay was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked. A letter from home found Lucien "Mud" Zachariahtay before the night shift. Lucien "Mud" Zachariahtay folded it small and kept it close.
Lucien "Mud" Zachariahtay heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.
